decisions.reason: The construction site dumper is relatively distant from the firm's existing machinery knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate market feedback and improve the product, so it is likely to be dropped.
The inclined furniture lift builds on related lifting and handling expertise, and the firm can learn from its own page and early results, making it more likely to be kept.
The inclined building material lift shares related knowledge with the firm's core machinery capabilities and the other lift products, supporting learning and improvement, so it is likely to be kept.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift, while more complex, still leverages the firm's lift-related knowledge and synergies with product D, so it is likely to be kept.
